{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the sales data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for unique values in status column
print("Unique values in 'status' column:")
print(df['status'].unique())

# Check for unique values in 'revenue' column
print("\nRevenue range:")
print(df['revenue'].describe())

# Check for internal test orders
# Since no column named 'is_test_order' exists, look for patterns
# Check if 'test' appears in any column that might indicate test orders
print("\nColumns that might indicate test orders:")
for col in df.columns:
    unique_vals = df[col].unique()
    if any('test' in str(val).lower() for val in unique_vals):
        print(f"  {col}: {unique_vals}")"}
